name: find_path
purpose: Synchronous point-to-point pathfinding returning path points + length + partial flag — the numeric verification primitive for all routing work.
cooked: works — uses in-memory navmesh; newly built nav on cooked maps is session-only
prevents: the documented 'nav build reports success with zero tiles' silent-failure class

name: project_to_navmesh
purpose: Snap an arbitrary world point onto the navmesh (or report it cannot be) — pre-flight check turning 'pawn refuses to move' into numbers.

name: random_reachable_point
purpose: Generate random reachable navmesh locations from an origin — the primitive for scattering ambient NPCs to wander.

name: nav_raycast
purpose: 2D navigable-space raycast — is there a straight walkable line from A to B; distinguishes detour-needed from unreachable.
hazards: engine returns obstructed=true when no nav data present — tiles==0 pre-check is load-bearing

name: navmesh_tile_info
purpose: Per-tile poly counts and bounds — turns nav_status's single tiles number into a spatial map exposing half-empty builds.
cooked: works — proves the shipped navmesh covers a given street

name: list_nav_areas
purpose: Enumerate every loaded UNavArea class with cost numbers so area-class params elsewhere take a validated name, not a guessed string.
cooked: works — cooked BPGC nav areas appear like native classes
hazards: FixedAreaEnteringCost is protected — must be read via FProperty reflection, not direct member

name: pie_move_pawn
purpose: Issue a tracked, tunable nav move (single dest or multi-point route) to an AI pawn in PIE — the walking-NPC endpoint.
cooked: works — runtime objects in PIE; running BTs may stomp manual moves (report requestIdChanged)
hazards: plugin-side FTSTicker leg queue: one status read + at most one MoveToLocation per tick, no blocking
gate leg-advance on DidMoveReachGoal(), not Status==Idle — else blocked pawns silently skip legs
weak controller refs so PIE teardown is a no-op, never a crash
a running BehaviorTree's next MoveTo stomps the manual move — status must report requestIdChanged

name: pie_move_status
purpose: The poll half of pie_move_pawn — numeric progress (status, leg index, remaining path length/cost) of a pawn's current move/route.
hazards: GetPathDestination carries meta DeprecatedFunction — prefer GetImmediateMoveDestination

name: pie_stop_move
purpose: Abort/pause/resume a pawn's current move or route cleanly and clear the plugin-side route queue.

name: pie_possess
purpose: Fix the #1 reason moves no-op — a controllerless pawn — by spawning its default AI controller or handing it to the player controller.
cooked: works — cooked pawns carry AIControllerClass in the BPGC CDO
hazards: PIE-teardown care needed; possession swap is not undoable and must not enter the transaction system

name: pie_get_perception
purpose: Read-only dump of what an AI currently/ever perceives in PIE — turns 'the guard doesn't react' into actor lists and counts.
cooked: works — how Phase-2 confirms cooked opponents' sense config without opening the BP

name: run_eqs_query
purpose: Run an existing UEnvQuery asset and read back scored locations — numeric ground truth for 'where would the AI go'.
cooked: works — cooked UEnvQuery assets are complete runtime objects; only the editor graph is stripped
hazards: wrapper is GC-unshielded after query finish — plugin TStrongObjectPtr map is mandatory
RunEQSQuery returns nullptr on null template/querier/manager — handler must check all three
EQS is time-sliced across frames — blocking would violate the game-thread rule; request+poll only
bucket corrected read-only -> self-managed: query registration + rooted transient wrapper is not pure

name: list_blackboard_keys
purpose: Enumerate a UBlackboardData asset's keys (own + inherited) with types — required reading before BT-adjacent work.
cooked: works — Keys is plain UPROPERTY data; editor-only description/category return null with cookedAsset flag

name: add_blackboard_key
purpose: Add a typed key to a loose UBlackboardData asset with duplicate/type/parent-chain validation and correct Instanced subobject creation.
cooked: refuses — cooked/pak-mounted asset cannot be saved and propagation would touch cooked assets
hazards: Instanced KeyType subobject must be outered to the BB asset
post-add IsValid()==false means parent-chain conflict — transaction must roll back

name: create_blackboard_asset
purpose: Create a new empty UBlackboardData asset (optionally with parent) so add_blackboard_key has a loose target.
cooked: works — creates loose assets only; pak-mounted target path rejected, cooked parent allowed
hazards: UBlackboardDataFactory is unexported — direct NewObject required (and sufficient; factory body is bare NewObject)

name: add_nav_modifier_volume
purpose: Place a volume stamping a UNavArea (cost/Null/Obstacle) onto the navmesh region it overlaps — 'never path through the drug lab'.
cooked: degraded — in-session effect on cooked maps but cannot be saved into them; warn, don't refuse
hazards: AreaClass is protected — SetAreaClass is the exported route and self-notifies the nav system
size param is strict-required — a silent default recreates the 'covers nothing' trap

name: add_nav_link
purpose: Spawn an ANavLinkProxy with validated simple point links — connects navmesh islands (stairs, ledges, doorways).
cooked: degraded — in-session effect on cooked maps, saving restricted to loose maps; warn
hazards: Left/Right are actor-relative (MakeEditWidget) — handler must convert world-space params
segment links are engine-dead (@todo, NavLinkProxy.h:42-45) — reject segment params by name
PostEditChangeProperty call site must be wrapped in #if WITH_EDITOR
